task_name: Fulfill Advisor Wood Offer, Collect & Re-queue Wood in All Factories, and Decline Nails Offer

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: Upon returning to your city when Wood logs are ready across the northern Small Factories and advisor Simoleon offers appear.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Selling 1 Wood for 22 Simoleons when 8+ Wood logs are ready to collect is profitable, whereas declining the advisor offer to sell your only Nail (1/1 for 67 Simoleons) preserves scarce crafted Nails needed for residential upgrades.
preconditions: Finished Wood floating above the Small Factories
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Accept the Wood trade offer, collect all finished Wood logs, refill the factories with Wood, and decline the Nails trade offer.

steps.who: Simoleon offer bubble near the northern factories
steps.briefing: open the advisor offer to buy 1 Wood for 22 Simoleons.

steps.who: floating Wood logs on the northern Small Factories
steps.briefing: collect all finished Wood logs into City Storage.
drag Wood logs into all empty factory production slots.

steps.who: new Simoleon offer bubble on the factory
steps.briefing: view the offer requesting 1/1 Nails for 67 Simoleons.
decline the offer so the Nails remain available for residential upgrades.
